rules.bcf: First usable model in Arnot-Gobas, CAESAR, Meylan order; require prediction and ADI >= 0.5.
rules.structure: Use locally generated Stage 3 qsar_smiles, never the model-report Basic | Smile_std. Count Cl/Br and attachment to six-member all-carbon aromatic rings. No trigger is unavailable, not zero.
rules.bioaccumulation: Maximum of selected BCF and structural score; BCF wins ties, retaining all tied bases.
rules.toxicity: Maximum usable endpoint; first endpoint wins ties. Ames has no ADI field; all endpoints remain subject to the identity gate.
rules.curated: Usable independent score, including zero, precedes curated fallback. PlastChem then alphabetical database order; retain the first numeric value, including 0.25.
rules.isolation: Reject leaked identity-review predictions; mask all B/T predictions when QSAR evidence is unavailable. Local structure and independent curated evidence remain eligible.
rules.annotations: GIC, NORMAN and toxicological labels are not scoring inputs; toxicological labels are retained only as audit context.
rules.historical: Restore predictions only from verified local Stage 3 artifacts; historical reproduction is never an eligible downstream result.
rules.missing: Unavailable evidence is not zero. Historical screening rules are not a new regulatory classification.
